observations: A vintage-style treadle sewing machine is shown on a wooden table with metal legs.
The machine has a black body with yellow decorative patterns and text.
The brand name 'BUTTERFLY' is visible in yellow lettering on the side of the machine head in photos 1, 2, and 3.
The machine has a handwheel on the right side, a presser foot, and a metal treadle foot pedal under the table.
The wooden table surface is reddish-brown and shows signs of wear and use.
The metal frame and legs show rust and wear, especially on the lower part.
The machine appears to be a manual treadle model, not electric.
No power cord or electrical components are visible in any photo.
The background includes fabric and other items, suggesting a workshop or storage environment.

claims.claim: In good condition working perfectly fine
claims.evidence: No photo shows the machine in operation. No proof of functionality is provided. The machine appears to be in used condition, but no test is shown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the needle, presser foot, and internal mechanisms (e.g., belt, gears) to check for wear or damage.

Close-up photos or video of the needle, presser foot, and internal mechanisms.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
